summary: WEB-ONLY frontend regression test for Wayly marketing/nav polish (iter 384). Verified: floating teal frosted-glass marketing header (rgba(14,77,82,0.75) + 24px backdrop-blur + 16px radius + 8px padding), Tools mega menu opens on hover with 9 tools and visual supporter column, hovering updates active state, clicking navigates to /ai-tools/<slug>, Escape closes it, 'Log In' label with no border, Start free trial routes to /signup?plan=family with hover glow class, signed-in avatar dropdown + signout works, app-download-prompt renders with QR (desktop) + Google Play CTA + dismiss persists to localStorage, AI Tools teaser (see-all-tools-cta y=4388) renders BEFORE Reports strip (y=4755), mobile drawer opens with Log In + Start free trial. InAppNudge correctly does NOT render on desktop (expected). No new console errors introduced by the new components.
critical_code_review_comments: MarketingHeader.jsx — the mobile drawer uses `fixed inset-0 top-0 pt-20` so it covers the frosted header; z-50 vs header z-40, OK. No blocker.
AppDownloadPrompt only shows QR when device==='both' (desktop); the request explicitly says desktop so this is correct, but on tablet/large phones a QR is also useful — minor UX nit, not a bug.

ToolsMegaMenu — close-on-mouse-leave is handled by the parent header's onMouseLeave with a 160ms timeout; this works, but hovering OUT of the menu bar quickly (e.g. toward content below) will still close as expected. OK.
